FULL TEXT:
University of Kashmir
NAAC Accredited Grade A+
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar 190006, Kashmir.
E X T E N S I O N N O T I C E
It is notified for the information of all the concerned that the date for submission of
online application forms for the posts of Deputy Registrar/Deputy Controller of
Examinations, Director, South Campus, Convocation complex, DIQA, IOT Zakura
and System Engineer (Software Development) advertised vide advertisement notice
dated 24-08-2023, 30-08-2023 and 12-09-2023 respectively has been extended for
10 days w.e.f. 06-10-2023 to 15-10-2023.
Further, the hard copies of the said application forms shall be deposited in the
Recruitment Section upto 17-10-2023.
No further extension whatsoever shall be granted.
Sd/-
